summary: Python-centric enterprise development with FastAPI web services, JSON Schema validation, agent-based architecture, and Docker containerization. Strong emphasis on modular agent design, tenant isolation, and schema-driven contracts.

rules.rule: Agent modules follow snake_case naming with descriptive suffixes (e.g., security_engineer.py, database_engineer.py)

provenance.evidence: Consistent snake_case naming across all agent modules

rules.rule: Schema files use descriptive names with version suffixes and .schema.json extension
FastAPI decorators (@app.get, @app.post) used for HTTP endpoint definition
Dedicated tester agent module for test automation and validation
Tenant-based isolation implemented through hierarchical directory structure
Security engineer agent handles authentication and authorization concerns

provenance.evidence: Dedicated security agent for auth concerns

lint_recommendations: Implement consistent import ordering across all agent modules
Add type hints to all agent method signatures
Standardize error handling patterns across FastAPI endpoints
Add docstrings to all agent classes and methods
Implement consistent logging patterns across all modules
scaffold_templates: agent_base_template.py - Base class template for new agent types
fastapi_endpoint_template.py - Standard endpoint structure with error handling
json_schema_template.json - Schema template with common validation patterns
docker_service_template - Container template for new services
